hints: Which block is moved only by friction? Its largest acceleration sets the limit.
worded:
1. F acts on B (lower). A is moved only by friction from B, at most μ m_A g, so A’s acceleration is at most μg = 5 m/s².

2. Moving together, both have 5 m/s²: F = (1 + 2) × 5 = 15 N.

3. Check: a larger F would need A to accelerate faster than friction allows, so A would slip back on B.
mistakes: With F on the lower block, a_max = μg, independent of the masses.
